verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents an official MCP server that works with any MCP-compatible client, including Claude, Codex, Cursor and VS Code/GitHub Copilot, and a probe confirms the docs page exists. The docs list concrete agent capabilities through natural language: debugging delivery errors with root-cause analysis, writing and testing transformations, reviewing tracking plans, detecting duplicate event names, reviewing audit logs and answering docs questions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server, and documented setup/authentication details for connecting an agent.
